newsitem.title: GHANA: Lawyer to run for Ghana president as independent.
newsitem.headline: Lawyer to run for Ghana president as independent.

text.p: A 43-year-old lawyer has joined the race for Ghana's December 7 presidential election, saying he will stand against President Jerry Rawlings and other established politicians as an independent.
Ahuma Ocansey, a senior official at the Ghana Export Promotion Council, described himself as "David against the Goliaths of Ghana politics" and said he had been inspired by God to stand.
"Greed, selfishness and mediocrity have become the new values of the nation, while the majority of the people are enslaved by poverty and want," he said in a statement issued on Thursday.

Rawlings will stand for his National Democratic Party. Two other candidates, John Agyekum Kuffuor of the New Patriotic Party and Edward Mahama of the People's National Convention, have also announced their intention to compete.
Ghana will hold parliamentary elections on the same day as the presidential poll.
